newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PZU life insurer Q3 net falls to PLN 58 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish PZU life insurer Q3 net falls to PLN 58 mln.

text.p: The net profit of Poland's PZU Life insurance company fell in the third quarter of this year to 58.2 million zlotys against 81.6 million in the same period of last year, the company said in a statement.
Pre-tax profit slipped to 66.8 million zlotys from 117.9 million zlotys.
Gross premiums in the third quarter rose to 1.6 billion zlotys from 1.2 a year earlier, it said. @
PZU Life, a subsidiary of the state-owned PZU insurance giant, said revenue from investments in the third quarter rose to 326.4 million zlotys against 266 million in the same period last year.
